open.title: V1 governance primary button fails the carbon contrast gate
open.measured: --accent-contrast (#ffffff) on --accent (#78a9ff) = 2.35:1; src/styles/tokens.test.ts 'keeps every declared foreground/background pair legible on operations-carbon' fails on docs/research-loop-plan tip 0d5ceaba without any UXM-07 change
open.not_fixed_because: UXM-07 is flag-off pixel-neutral and may not edit V1 CSS or accepted baselines. A one-line fix (color: var(--paper), as execution.css:5981 already does) changes V1 governance button pixels and needs a baseline decision.
open.proposed: Codex or Bobby approves color: var(--paper) on line 7278 and a re-recorded governance baseline; V2 buttons never use --accent-contrast on --accent.

open.title: R2 persistence ledger lacks the V2 operations queue table
open.where: apps/portal/frontend/src/execution/r2Ledger.test.ts:117 ('covers every execution/governance table the control-api names in SQL')
open.measured: missing: execution_operation_queue_v2 (added by Codex with executionF0BlockedOperationsListV2); fails on docs/research-loop-plan tip 0d5ceaba without any UXM-07 change
open.not_fixed_because: The ledger names persistence ownership for Codex tables; adding a row is Codex's ownership decision, not a frontend appearance change.
open.proposed: Codex adds the table to the R2 ledger (or states it is out of scope) in the next landing turn.

open.title: e2e BFF double does not answer the UDB-03 retained-review read
open.measured: e2e/execution-preview.spec.ts 'every product route consumes the same-origin BFF' fails on docs/research-loop-plan tip: 501 on GET /api/v1/execution/retained-review for every route (29 console errors). Reproduced on a flag-off preview build, so it predates UXM-07.
open.not_fixed_because: Serving a 200 body would flip every screen into retained (read-only) mode and a 404 still logs a console error; which stub the double should serve is a test-contract decision for the owner of the V1 spec. The V2 spec tolerates exactly this one URL and its console line (execution-v2-s1.spec.ts).
open.proposed: Codex/Bobby decide the stub (e.g. canonical execution-retained-review.valid.json with a non-retained scope) and re-green execution-preview.spec.
